title: Alias routing
prompt: Ask for a known concept using a documented alias rather than the canonical document title.
required_assertions: Resolve the alias to the correct owning knowledge domain before answering.
Use the owning document as the primary retrieved source.
forbidden_assertions: Guess a different family because the wording is non-canonical.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.

title: Domain isolation
prompt: Ask a Furniture-specific question while unrelated Code/UI documents are also retrievable.
required_assertions: Prioritize the Furniture owner document and only retrieve cross-domain material when a concrete dependency exists.
forbidden_assertions: Let unrelated high-salience Code/UI content override the Furniture contract.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.

title: Retrieval miss fails closed
prompt: Ask for an API/member not present in the retrieved canonical evidence.
required_assertions: Return an explicit retrieval/evidence gap and research-needed state.
forbidden_assertions: Invent the missing API/member or silently infer it from a neighboring concept.
pass_rule: Pass only if every required assertion is satisfied and no forbidden assertion is present.
